text.tspan: Number of people living in the world's largest cities
Estimated number of people living in cities ranked among the top 100 most populous in 2020. City boundaries
are defined using a consistent global approach based on satellite imagery and population data.

tspan.tspan: Because city boundaries follow a standardized global approach rather than national definitions, estimates may differ from official country
